evidence.activity: Branded retail storage products sold to casual users, gamers and creative professionals
evidence.quote: Our retail channel primarily serves casual users, gamers and creative professionals through branded storage products sold directly to retailers or through our distribution partners.

creativity.criterion: level 1: general-purpose storage marketed partly to creative professionals, with no creator-specific product or figures

evidence.activity: Mentoring, coaching, technical and leadership training for employees
evidence.quote: We also provide mentoring, coaching, technical and leadership training, on-the-job learning and other professional development opportunities.

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size

evidence.activity: Employee volunteer STEM educational programming for students and local community partnerships
evidence.quote: During fiscal year 2026, these efforts included educational programming for students, environmental cleanup and tree-planting activities, and community partnerships across our global locations.

community.criterion: level 2: specific current external education and community activity, with no reach figures disclosed

evidence.activity: Voluntary employee-led Employee Resource Groups supported by company leaders
evidence.quote: Our ERGs operate through 32 chapters across eight countries and are supported by Seagate leaders.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital > Culture of Inclusion

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: employee networks with chapter counts but no membership figures

evidence.activity: Company recognition of cultural and heritage events across global locations
evidence.quote: We also recognize cultural and heritage events across our global locations to reflect the diverse backgrounds and experiences of our employees and strengthen connections across our workforce.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital > Culture of Inclusion

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current internal cultural practice, limited in disclosed reach

evidence.activity: Company's own research and development in storage technology
evidence.quote: Research and development (“R&D”) is central to our long-term growth strategy.

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: the company's own innovation only

creativity.reason: Level 1: general-purpose storage is sold to creative professionals among several customer groups, with no creator-specific product line or figures, so the lower level was chosen when torn.

community.reason: Level 2: employee development plus specific current STEM education and community partnerships, with no participant or dollar figures to support level 3.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: employee resource groups (32 chapters, eight countries, no membership figures) and cultural heritage events; coverage is insufficient under condition 2 because the inclusion discussion is under about 150 words.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: only the company's own innovation and R&D, with no small-business or founder enabling service.

ai.notes: The Item 7 excerpt covers only liquidity and contains no theme-relevant activity. 'Creative workflows' in the Edge IoT product description refers to the same consumer storage activity as E1 and is not counted separately. The following are not counted: 'content delivery', 'create ... data', product and chip 'design', patent 'licensing', 'foundation' meaning technology base, and health and safety training (compliance). The filing points to a Sustainability Report for sustainability information only. The cross-cultural 'insufficient' coverage (word-count condition 2) triggers the second look. The 25,000 employees in Asia figure is location data and is not scored. Cross-cultural was held at 2 rather than 3 because chapter counts are not membership figures. Entrepreneurship was scored 1 for own innovation per the level-1 ladder text, even though 'innovation' is listed as a trap for enabling evidence.
